vision.fallback_reason: Isaac Sim 4.5 D455 USD color prim carries unsupported cameraProjectionType metadata; capture uses a pinhole camera with the D455 color intrinsics

metadata.ground_truth_source: Isaac Sim PhysX Cube.get_world_pose at exposure time
metadata.camera_source: RGB + ArUco + solvePnP + fixed camera calibration only
metadata.pairing: nearest 120 Hz reference within half a physics step; duplicate images excluded

trajectory_cache.invalidation_reason: old joint-interpolated contact/release samples lack force control and Cartesian monotonicity

contact_state_recognition.reference_definition: independent physical contacts/attachments plus 50 um wall adjacency; no wrist force or task phase
contact_state_recognition.control: observer only; skill recommendations do not change robot commands
limitations: Single normal proxy-contact task is a baseline, not research-grade generalization evidence.
Unloaded geometric contact can be unobservable; UNKNOWN counts against accuracy/coverage.
Camera outage is sensor replay, not a simulated physical disconnection.
